source.title: Are ore Prospecting and DE even profitable specs, or just a trap? — firsthand Q2 Serevite report

quote: Prospected 100 q2 severite and got 1 epic gem.
notes: First-person unsystematic Reddit comment, 2022-12-25: 100 quality-2 Serevite ore are a NOMINAL input quantity; Resourcefulness saved/refunded ore and actual completed prospect operation count were not reported, so casts and 0-N histogram remain null. Output is described only as an 'epic gem' without exact item, rank, or whether it was a single-output cast; do NOT assign a particular Illimited Diamond ID or claim observed P(hit). Quality-2 Serevite mapped to 190396 from separate ranked-item metadata (https://github.com/t-mart/wow-auction/blob/master/README.md), not from the author or an official tooltip. inputsPerCast=5 is separately verified Dragon Isles Prospecting recipe mechanic (spell 374627), NOT a basis to infer actual operations. Skill, specialization, refunds, recipe build and author are unknown. This is a new small original outcome count, not an independent randomized sampling estimate.

source.title: Name-first Dragonflight source-original prospect/mill zero-inclusive histogram search

notes: Six named, site-scoped searches across Reddit, Blizzard US forums, Wowhead and Warcraft Wiki found no unindexed independent completed-cast/0-N output-event table for Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting or Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling. Known originals were not duplicated. The independent tiny Q2 Serevite one-gem anecdote is preserved in this file as a different record; it does not close the histogram or denominator gap.
